name: vlogops
description: BUILD-006 Phases 1-3 — the durable Content Seed store, the three human-initiated intake routes, the Source Compiler, and Scribe. A seed's identity is a function of its content and nothing else; captured source bytes are frozen at intake so a source edited, corrupted or deleted afterwards cannot rewrite history; the same source taken in twice yields one seed; and an intake killed mid-flight recovers to exactly one correct state with nobody re-running it. The compiler turns a sealed seed into a bounded, deduplicated, chronological, provenance-complete evidence pack whose identity is likewise a pure function of its content, reading only the frozen snapshots and never the original source. Scribe turns that pack into a versioned Master Story Package: one canonical creative truth, with script, blog, titles and thumbnail direction stored as projections of cited rows, so a sibling that cites nothing, cites outside the pack, or asserts something the master does not is unwritable rather than merely discouraged. Additive-only `vlogops` schema — it never touches asdair, session_report, ops, tower or any other namespace.
